final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely narrowed the claim to a caveated interpretation of the same record. That reinterpretation is partially more disciplined than the original certification framing, but it still does not satisfy the policy predicate on the present evidence. The policy allows certification only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The available summary still indicates a 2.1 percentage point Spanish-language billing support regression, with no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or attached disclosure language shown. That means the issue is not merely a caveat on an otherwise complete record; it is an unresolved compliance condition. A caveated position could become supportable if the current-release documentation and disclosure were actually evidenced, but that evidence is not present in this role's record.
